occurrence_evidence.claim: At launch, Fable 5 redirected elementary biology and ordinary medical-science prompts to Opus 4.8; Anthropic said the safety filters were intentionally conservative and blocked most biology-work queries while false positives were reduced.
The redirect visibly identified the switch to Opus 4.8 and allowed users to continue on that model instead of leaving the request blocked.
In August Anthropic described rewriting the classifier’s constitution, revising training data and retaining restrictions on dual-use professional biology.
Anthropic later reported that Fable 5.1 intervened on benign biology requests 85 percent less often than the launch safeguards.
Current help text says checks cover wider conversation context; fallback retains the Opus selection until changed. API switching requires separate opt-in configuration.
